ValidationRule.description: Users cannot change status to Declined for internal funding records
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Status__c), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Declined'), OR( CONTAINS(Lender_Name_Workflow__c, 'National Funding'), CONTAINS(Lender_Name_Workflow__c, 'Quick Bridge'), Lender_Name_Workflow__c ='MLP' ) , $Setup.ValidationRules__c.Allow_Funding_Status_Updates__c = FALSE )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot update the status for internal funding.
